verification_gaps.summary: The mandatory whole-repository acceptance gates had not yet been independently evidenced for this uncommitted write slice.
verification_gaps.evidence: At review time the evidence covered focused tests, SQLite/D1 tests, delegated live PostgreSQL tests, TypeScript, targeted lint/format and diff checks, but did not yet establish pnpm ci:check, the one-worker full suite, production build and staged whitespace check.
verification_gaps.impact: This security-sensitive cross-cutting change touches OAuth, transport-time tool registration, shared Growth projection and schemas; targeted checks alone could not establish repository-wide regression safety.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Record sequential results for pnpm ci:check, the one-worker full test suite, the 4 GB-capped production build and both unstaged and staged git diff --check commands before final acceptance.

do_not_change: Preserve the default/API-key offline_access mcp scope set, minimal protected-resource mcp metadata, callback-level grant/props no-escalation checks, capability-before-project authorization, discovery plus invocation defenses, external-MCP-only registration, fixed manual/agent provenance, principal-namespaced idempotency, delegation to existing Change Event validation/atomicity and the shared privacy projector.
